replication.target_description: NVIQ change over baseline and three annual assessments, EIBI versus SAU; age-adjusted linear mixed-model time-by-treatment interaction (difference in slopes).

notes:
Locator p. S150 and description jointly identify two distinct tests, so single-test n/es/p fields left null. Table 2 prints language comprehension F 3.82 with EIBT n 21 and comparison n 19; narrative p. S152 prints p = .06. Merrill-Palmer prints ns with EIBT n 21 and comparison n 16; numeric F and p not printed. Values were not merged across tests. Replication full text unavailable.
Source follow-up: Publisher online-first article/proof from private Drive archive; final bibliographic pagination retained separately; Crossref independently matches requested DOI, title and authors; title coverage in first3PDFpages=1.0, author surnames found=Waters,Amerine Dickens,Thurston,Lu,Smith. PDF has24pages; published range=3-26; source endmatter checked in model review. Methods-related material pages[1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12]; results-related material pages[2, 3, 11, 12, 16, 18, 19, 20]; references atPDFpages[20]. No statistical target comparison. Publisher cover sheets, online-first versions and end notices retained and labelled. Rendered primary Table 3 and outcome narrative inspected. Selects the authors’ explicitly tested between-group difference in improvement (time × treatment), not the treatment intercept. N retains printed observation unit; participant analytic N is not separately printed per model. Significance is bounded by the printed star legend, not exact p. Locator description also mentions language comprehension; this source labels its corresponding outcome NVIQ/nonverbal IQ and has no separate language-comprehension outcome here. Table 3 prints interaction b=0.233 whereas p.16 narrative says 0.234 and 3.168 per year; retained the requested p.15 table value without correction.
